findings.summary: The remediation ledger was not cryptographically bound to the exact bytes of the audit-source-result it claimed to close: source.audit_report_sha256 differed from the SHA-256 of audit-source-result.json.

summary: Independent re-audit rejected the terminal delivery package because audit-remediation.json referenced a stale source hash. Product material remained unchanged; remediation is limited to the result-only handoff package.
